title: Replace an RSA or RCG competency card
summary: You can request a replacement for a lost, stolen, or damaged RSA or RCG competency card online.
intro:
If your RSA and/or RCG competency card has been lost, stolen or damaged, you can request a replacement card online.

Make sure your email address or mobile phone number is on record with Liquor & Gaming NSW.

Rather than pay the replacement card fee, you may prefer to access a free digital version of your competency card through the Service NSW app.

If you have completed the Advanced Responsible Conduct of Gambling (ARCG) course:

For up-to-date information, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW: Training.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor and gaming training contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Your RSA and/or RCG competency card must have been lost, stolen, or damaged.
Your email address or mobile phone number must be on record with Liquor & Gaming NSW.
what_you_need: The reason why you need to replace your card

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Manage your RSA/RCG card' button.
Follow the prompts to replace your card.

more_info.text: If you do not need a replacement card, but do need to update your contact details, you can use the online form.
It can take up to 5 weeks to get your new card.

faqs.q: What should I do if my RSA or RCG competency card is lost, stolen, or damaged?
faqs.a: You can request a replacement card online.

faqs.q: Is there a free way to access my competency card?
faqs.a: You may access a free digital version of your competency card through the Service NSW app instead of paying the replacement card fee.

faqs.q: Who should I contact with questions about liquor and gaming training?
faqs.a: Contact Liquor & Gaming NSW for questions or feedback about liquor and gaming training.
